Diet proportion draws from a MixSIAR fit

Source: R/compare.R
mixsiar_draws.Rd

Turns the output of MixSIAR::run_model() into the long data frame that compare_mixsiar() and plot_compare() take, named as in MixSIAR's summary statistics (p.global.<source>, p.<level label>.<source>).

Usage

mixsiar_draws(jags.1, mix, source)

Arguments

jags.1

The output of MixSIAR::run_model().

mix, source

The mix and source objects used for that fit (from MixSIAR's or this package's loaders).

Value

A data frame with columns name and value.
